title: Monocyte–HDL context and CRP prediction: failed spline transfer and a stabilized cross-cycle sensitivity analysis
abstract: The prespecified unregularized spline model failed transfer (target MSE 5918.131 versus linear 1.141). A posthoc stabilized monocyte–HDL interaction did not improve prediction: target log-CRP MSE reduction -0.000825 beyond a nonlinear-plus-MHR baseline, with Rao–Wu two-sample-refit 95% interval [-0.008054, 0.001256]; this is exploratory, not untouched confirmation or a clinical biomarker validation.
